scope: Agent visual assessment of matched baseline/candidate images and native crops; not official scores or independent human naturalness ratings.

socket_integration.reason: Lid margins, creases and tear-duct contact integrate the eye with the surrounding face; enlarged nine-pose crops show no obvious gap or collision.

eye_appearance.reason: Softer iris/sclera transition and more coherent wet shading reduce the inserted-disc appearance, while simplified non-refractive eyes remain evident.

skin_response.reason: Regional roughness, restrained subsurface response and shaped illumination give more volume than the flatter baseline. This is still a synthetic MPFB face.

grooming.reason: Tapered geometric lashes are less heavy than the original fan cards; the seeded short scalp groom is coherent in front and three-quarter portraits. Existing directional brow maps are retained.

pupil_readability.reason: All five direction/reset checks and all nine anchor image/mask checks pass unchanged thresholds; pupils remain visibly clear across matched views.

limitations: Short scalp groom is stylized; existing brow textures retained
